item.tib: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sgrub pa las skong bshags nyon mongs rang grol
item.coloph: ces skyabs gnas 'dus gtso mchog gsum drin can bla ma'i sgrub pa bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng ba las/ skong chung nyon mongs rang grol zhes bya ba 'di yang / bstan pa'i dpal yon du gyur pa'i spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags mchog gis bka' gsung spyi bor phab pa dang ma zad lung rtogs bon gyi gnas lngas phyug pa'i rigs mthun gyi grogs po brtse gdung gcig tu 'dres pa'i btsun pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis rten 'brel legs mtshon spyi blugs dang lha rdzas dar dkar gyis sna drangs bskul ba brten/ bka' gsung gyen ldog ma nus nas/ rgod rje'i rus thob tshe dbang bde chen snying pos bon gyi 'dus sde dpal ldan nor gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du spel ba 'dis kyang / sa lam nyams rtogs bskyed cing lta sgom yang rtser phyin pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
